Question 10

A particle starts moving from the point with position vector (−i+j)mm with an acceleration of (2i−6j)mm/min2 and an initial velocity of (−3i+2j)mm/min. Find the position vector of the particle after 5 minutes.

a
(25i+36j)mm
b
(3i−8j)mm
c
(16i+49j)mm
d
(9i−64j)mm
e
(4i−7j)mm
